text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm sorry your monstera arrived with yellow leaves and you've seen a double charge. That's a stressful combination, so let's go through each part.

**1. Yellow leaves on your monstera**

- Yellowing on one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is usually normal transplant stress, and on its own it isn't covered.
- If the plant arrived damaged (snapped main stem, cracked pot, exposed roots, or dead or severely wilted), report it as Damaged on Arrival **within 48 hours of delivery**. Include photos of the plant and the box. We'd send a free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or a refund.
- If it's past 48 hours, or the problem develops later, the **30-day Plant Care Guarantee** applies (90 days for Leafy Plus members). Make a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within **2 business days**. Covered problems include losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse.
- In the meantime, keep it out of direct sun for the first week, don't repot for 2-3 weeks, and water only when the top inch of soil is dry.

When did it arrive? That will tell me which route fits best.

**2. Being charged twice**

- Cards are authorised at checkout and charged when the order ships, so one of the two may just be a **pending authorisation** that will drop off. An order shipped in several parcels can also show one charge per parcel.
- If both charges have fully posted, send me your **order number** (it looks like LF-123456) and the **last four digits** of the card. Please don't share the full card number or security code. Once confirmed, the duplicate is refunded within **3 business days**, and then takes **5-10 business days** to show on a card (3-5 for digital wallets).

**3. Refund to a different card**

I'm sorry, but I can't do this. Refunds can only go back to the **original payment method**, even if that card has been closed or expired. Banks normally pass the refund on to a replacement card. If you'd rather not wait, you can take **Leafy store credit** instead, which is issued instantly and never expires.

If you'd still like to ask for a different card, I can pass your request to a Support Lead to review. I can't promise the outcome.

Would you like me to do that, or go ahead with any of the options above? Please reach out anytime. 🌿
